_status: SKELETON — structural predictions committed 2026-09-01. Quantitative ranges are filled when engine/ is built, before any deciding data is read.

P1.what: a deconfinement mass exists above the Planck scale  (THE FALSIFIER)
P1.structural: M_dec = c^4 / (G^(3/2) * sqrt(B)),  B = MIT bag constant, B^(1/4) in [145, 235] MeV.  M_dec must exceed M_Planck ~ 2.18e-8 kg.
P1.expect_order: ~1e31 kg, order 10 solar masses; committed band 1-100 M_sun over the B^(1/4) spread
P1.kills_claim_if: M_dec < M_Planck, OR the interior reaches stiff-matter (Zel'dovich) density before evaporation removes enough mass to reach M_dec

P2.structural: E_bang ~ M_dec c^2  minus the gravitational binding already radiated away; order M_dec c^2
P2.expect_order: ~1e48 J for M_dec ~ 10 M_sun  (~1e4 core-collapse supernovae, in one event)

P3.structural: Planckian (blackbody) after adiabatic expansion by R_final / R_dec; NOT a power law, NOT a line spectrum
P3.expect: spectral SHAPE matches the CMB; absolute temperature set by the model-determined expansion factor

P4.what: angular distribution of the Bang radiation
P4.structural: anisotropic - collimated along the infall / boundary-crossing axis (the one-way portal)

P5.what: the matching boundary is exactly flat
P5.structural: the effective curvature invariant (Kretschmann / effective Ricci) crosses zero at the interior/exterior matching surface, and that surface coincides with the photon sphere r = 3 G M_dec / c^2
P5.expect: curvature invariant = 0 at the seam; tangent cone at the lemniscate node = two straight lines (the hard cross); pi is the constant of that flat boundary (Ainulindale/wiki/22); conformal boundary sc = 1.0
P5.kills_sub_claim_if: the zero-curvature locus and the photon sphere do not coincide in the model

P6.what: state of the pocket cosmos one trillion years after the Bang
P6.structural: evolve the released de Sitter phase for 1e12 yr; report relic temperature, expansion state, and characteristic structure scale, against the CMB-derived history as the yardstick
P6.expect: committed as ranges when the engine runs (step 1)
